asked.item: Codex can't attach local mp4 to blotato_create_post
Right sequence for a file on the laptop

verdict.reason: The help pages give the upload sequence for a local file: get a presigned URL, PUT the bytes, then pass publicUrl to blotatocreatepost.

steps.text: blotatocreatepost does not accept local file paths, so media must be a publicly accessible URL.
Make sure the assistant has access to the file and an HTTP upload tool.
Call blotatocreatepresigneduploadurl with the filename, including the extension, and it returns a presignedUrl and a publicUrl.
Upload the raw file bytes to presignedUrl with an HTTP PUT, not JSON and not multipart form data.
Check that the upload succeeded before using publicUrl.
Pass the returned publicUrl in the mediaUrls field of blotatocreatepost.
